verdict.rationale: Prefix or KV caching is a fair performance question for a local LLM inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions prefix caching, prompt caching, or KV-cache reuse for repeated prompts. Concurrency and throughput claims (multiple models, dedicated capacity) and community benchmarks are adjacent performance features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
